mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbox_event (id, event_type, routing_key, subject, payload, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{eventType}, #{routingKey}, #{subject}, #{payload}::jsonb, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, event_type, routing_key, subject, payload::text AS payload, created_at FROM outbox_event WHERE published_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at, id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox_event SET published_at = #{publishedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
